tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: egelloC Yellow, core colour: every asset carries it with Deep. Fills, pills, rules and bands; never type on white or Off White (~1.8:1).

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: egelloC Deep, core colour: dark blocks, containers and shapes only, never a full-page wash. Text on white, Off White and Yellow.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: True Black: body copy on white and Off White.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Charcoal: body copy in long digital layouts on white and Off White.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Supporting, never dominant: links, focus ring, error and problem states (there is no red), Navy blocks.

tokens.name: accent-yellow
tokens.usage: Supporting accent yellow: highlight surfaces and Free badges; never dominant.

tokens.usage: Off White: alternate page ground and grouping panels.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure White: page ground; type on Deep, Navy and scrimmed photography only.
